wiki.title: Jennifer Boysko
wiki.extract: Jennifer Barton Boysko (born November 16, 1966) is an American politician from the Commonwealth of Virginia. She has served as a member of the Virginia Senate since 2019, when she won a special election to replace fellow-Democrat Jennifer Wexton, who was vacating the seat to serve in the United States House of Representatives. Boysko represented Virginia's 33rd Senate district until 2024, then began representing the 38th district from that year onward as a result of redistricting.
